thread:
alex: Heads-up — staging fired the latency-burnrate alert on /chat-stream a few minutes ago. P95 token-level latency jumped.
maria: I pulled traces. The tail jumps around token positions ~48-64 for long-context requests. Looks like a kernel fallback path triggered.
jamie: Which fallback? last rollout had a selector change for small-batch -> fallback-int8 kernel.
maria: Exactly. KV hit rate dropped concurrently: kv_cache_hit_rate by route went from ~97% -> ~79% for those requests.
alex: Do we have the promql you used to see per-token latency? paste pls.
maria: Prometheus queries I used:
```
# p95 per-token latency for /chat-stream
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(token_latency_seconds_bucket{route="/chat-stream"}[5m])) by (le, token_pos))

# kv cache hit ratio by token position
sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total{route="/chat-stream"}[5m])) by (token_pos) /
(sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total{route="/chat-stream"}[5m])) by (token_pos) + sum(rate(kv_cache_misses_total{route="/chat-stream"}[5m])) by (token_pos))
```
Note: token_pos is an emitted label from the runtime instrumentation.

jamie: Nice. I also ran perf profiler on the fallback kernel: lots of memcopy and unoptimized attention path. Adds ~6-12ms per token at tail.
sre-bot: [alert] latency_burnrate_rule fired for service=runtime (link: https://grafana.internal/alerts/5421) :rotating_light:

nina: Suggestion — adjust burn-rate alerting window and threshold for this route while we investigate. Current burn rate threshold is 0.04 over 1m which is noisy for bursty long-context tests.
chris: Agreed. Proposal:
- change burn rate window to 5m
- use rolling MAD anomaly detector on per-token p95 to reduce flaps
- add a KV miss rate sub-alert: page if kv_miss_rate > 0.15 for 3m

maria: I think the root cause is selector prioritizing kernel that doesn't support prefix-KV reuse well. We should revert rollout to 0% for that selector and re-run benchmark suite.
jamie: I'll open a dashboard PR with panels:
- per-route token histogram: p50/p95/p99 across token_pos
- KV hit/miss heatmap by token_pos
- kernel-selection distribution by route
- burn-rate rule panel with recent fired annotations

alex: Action items:
- jamie: create dashboard + grafana panels and add MAD anomaly detection (ETA: 2h)
- maria: open perf regression PR to rollback selector rollout to 0% in staging and add regression test (ETA: 30m)
- chris: tune alert thresholds and add KV-miss sub-alert (ETA: 1h)
- nina: coordinate paging policy with oncall if alerts persist (@oncall)

jamie: Created PRs: runtime#4321 (rollback selector), grafana#210 (dash panels). Links: https://git.internal/runtime/pull/4321 , https://grafana.internal/d/rtk/per-token-kpis
maria: I pushed a short perf test that reproduces tail: `scripts/perf/run_long_ctx.sh --length 1024 --batch 4` — reproduces the extra 8ms/token after token 48.
alex: Thanks. If alerts still flapping after adjustments, we'll page. For now mark incident as "investigating" and mute non-urgent notifications for /chat-stream burn-rate for 15m. :thumbsup:

nina: acked, will watch the dashboard and update oncall if it spikes again.
chris: small follow-up: we should add per-model quantization flag to instrumentation so we can correlate kernel selection + quant config.
jamie: noted, adding to dashboard backlog.

sre-bot: Incident status updated -> investigating (incident id: INC-2026-117) :white_check_mark:

alex: cool — keeping this thread for any quick updates. If anyone finds a config diff that caused selector to pick the fallback, paste it here.
maria: will do, pushing more traces shortly.
